card.title: SUPPORT COLUMN
card.text: Give a unit: "Adjacent ground units have +1 attack and operate for 1 less."
card.flavorText: In a military context, a support column typically refers to a convoy of vehicles and personnel that provide logistical support to troops engaged in combat operations. The support column may transport supplies, ammunition, food, water, fuel, and medical equipment to the troops in the field. The support column is a critical element of military operations because it ensures that troops have the resources they need to sustain themselves and carry out their missions. Without a reliable support column, troops may become vulnerable to enemy attacks and may not be able to operate effectively for an extended period of time.
